headline: Shankara Buildpro, Mold-Tek Packaging, and Transport Corporation of India set corporate action dates
hook: Record dates set for three corporate actions
summary: Shankara Buildpro has fixed October 8 as the record date for its upcoming corporate action. Mold-Tek Packaging and Transport Corporation of India have both set October 9 as their respective record dates. Investors holding shares as of these dates will be eligible for the announced corporate benefits. Retail shareholders should check specific entitlements for each company before the record dates.
whats_next: Record dates on October 8 and October 9
why_it_matters: Hold shares before record dates to be eligible for actions

headline: Mold-Tek Technologies submits SEBI depository compliance certificate
hook: Routine compliance filing submitted by Mold-Tek
summary: Mold-Tek Technologies has submitted its mandatory compliance certificate under the SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018, to the stock exchange. This is a routine regulatory filing verifying dematerialization and depository operations for the period. For an Indian retail investor, this procedural filing carries no immediate financial or stock price impact.
why_it_matters: Routine paperwork with no financial impact on your investment.

headline: NMDC, MoldTek, and others set record dates for dividends and splits
hook: Corporate actions lined up this week
summary: Several listed companies including NMDC, PH Capital, MoldTek, and GTV have announced record dates this week for corporate actions such as dividends, stock splits, and bonus issues. Shareholders holding the shares as of the record date will be eligible for these respective corporate benefits. Retail investors tracking these stocks need to note the specific ex-date and record date schedules to qualify. These routine capital restructuring and payout events affect near-term share price adjustments.
whats_next: Record dates scheduled throughout the week
why_it_matters: Check record dates to qualify for upcoming dividends and splits

headline: Ten stocks including NMDC and BLS E-Services turn ex-record date this week
hook: Ten corporate actions hitting record dates
summary: Ten companies have set their record dates this week for corporate actions such as bonus issues, stock splits, and dividends. Firms participating include NMDC, BLS E-Services, GTV Engineering, PTC India, Shankara Buildpro, and Mold-Tek Technologies. Eligible shareholders as of the record date will receive the respective corporate benefits. Retail investors holding these stocks should verify their holdings ahead of the ex-date.
whats_next: Ex-date trading for the listed stocks this week
why_it_matters: Verify shareholdings before ex-dates to qualify for corporate benefits
